hook: 主庫差集 Q 專場：佇列診所——把還沒進幽默庫的詞請上台對號入座。
script: quack／quaff／quail／quaint／qualify／qualm 先登台。其餘同字母 orphan 接龍站位。導播：這不是字典朗讀，是差集清剿晚會；每個詞帶一個角色名牌以免走失。

members.senseAnchor: an untrained person who pretends to be a physician and who dispenses medical advice; the harsh sound of a duck
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-庸醫: quack walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-庸醫」出場：quack 一上場梗就黏住——庸醫。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-v. 大: quaff walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-v. 大」出場：quaff 一上場梗就黏住——v. 大口地喝。

members.senseAnchor: flesh of quail; suitable for roasting or broiling if young; otherwise must be braised; small gallinaceous game birds
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-畏縮: quail walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-畏縮」出場：quail 一上場梗就黏住——畏縮。

related.synonyms: flinch, squinch, funk, cringe, shrink, wince

members.senseAnchor: strange in an interesting or pleasing way; very strange or unusual; odd or even incongruous in character or appearance; - Bill Beatty; - Sir Walter Scott
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-離奇的: quaint walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-離奇的」出場：quaint 一上場梗就黏住——離奇的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-限制；給: qualify walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-限制；給」出場：qualify 一上場梗就黏住——限制；給予資格。

related.synonyms: restrict, dispose, stipulate, condition, specify, characterize

members.senseAnchor: uneasiness about the fitness of an action; a mild state of nausea
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-疑慮，不: qualm walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-疑慮，不」出場：qualm 一上場梗就黏住——疑慮，不安。

members.senseAnchor: enforced isolation of patients suffering from a contagious disease in order to prevent the spread of disease; isolation to prevent the spread of infectious disease
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-隔離: quarantine walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-隔離」出場：quarantine 一上場梗就黏住——隔離。

members.senseAnchor: put down by force or intimidation; declare invalid
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-鎮壓: quash walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-鎮壓」出場：quash 一上場梗就黏住——鎮壓。

related.synonyms: repress, subdue, subjugate, reduce, invalidate, annul

members.senseAnchor: offensive term for an openly homosexual man; hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of
members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-奇怪的: queer walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-奇怪的」出場：queer 一上場梗就黏住——奇怪的。

related.synonyms: fagot, faggot, fag, fairy, nance, pansy

members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-v. 壓: quell walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-v. 壓」出場：quell 一上場梗就黏住——v. 壓制。

members.senseAnchor: satisfy (thirst); put out, as of fires, flames, or lights

members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-熄滅」出場：quench 一上場梗就黏住——熄滅。

members.senseAnchor: to find fault or criticize for petty reasons

members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-v. 挑」出場：quibble 一上場梗就黏住——v. 挑剔，吹毛求疵。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the Q席-adj.: quintessential walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「Q席-adj.」出場：quintessential 一上場梗就黏住——adj. 典範的。

members.senseAnchor: a strange attitude or habit; a narrow groove beside a beading
